_about: Recipe pages taken down because another page is the same dish. Each old URL answers a permanent (301) redirect to the page that stays: .htaccess on the live host, _redirects (written by the build) and vercel.json elsewhere. tools/retired-recipes-check.js (part of npm run check) holds the three to this list. Never reuse a slug listed here for a different dish.

australian-cheese-and-vegemite-scrolls.reason: Same dish: scone-dough scrolls with Vegemite and cheddar. vegemite-scrolls was published first (8 October 2026).

fluffy-pancakes.reason: Same dish: fluffy American buttermilk pancakes. buttermilk-pancakes (Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes) was published first (5 September 2026).

sticky-date-cake.reason: Same dish: date sponge soaked with toffee sauce, same method and tin. sticky-date-pudding is the dish's usual name.

slow-cooker-split-pea-soup.reason: Same dish: split peas and ham hock on low in the slow cooker. slow-cooker-pea-and-ham-soup was published first (8 October 2026).

chicken-tagine-olives.reason: Same dish: bone-in chicken braised with preserved lemon and green olives, 45 then 15 minutes. Both published 5 September 2026; moroccan-chicken-tagine carries the dish's usual name.

potato-salad.reason: Same dish: American potato salad, waxy potatoes dressed warm with vinegar, then mayonnaise, mustard, egg, celery and pickle. classic-potato-salad was published first (5 September 2026).

coleslaw.reason: Same dish: salted and drained cabbage and carrot in a mayonnaise, cider vinegar, mustard and sugar dressing. creamy-coleslaw was published first (6 September 2026).

naan.reason: Same dish: the naan page was itself garlic naan (yoghurt dough, dry smoking cast-iron pan, garlic butter). garlic-naan was published first (5 September 2026).

kartoffelsalat.reason: Same dish: warm German potato salad in a bacon, vinegar and hot stock dressing, no mayonnaise. german-potato-salad was published first (5 September 2026).

grilled-cheese.reason: Same dish: two-cheese sandwich with mayonnaise and butter outside, cooked slowly over medium-low heat. grilled-cheese-sandwich was published first (5 September 2026).

lamb-rogan-josh.reason: Same dish: Kashmiri lamb shoulder in yoghurt with Kashmiri chilli, fennel and dried ginger, same method. Both published 5 September 2026; rogan-josh carries the dish's usual name.

moules-mariniere.reason: Same dish: mussels steamed in white wine with shallot, garlic and parsley. moules-marinieres was published first (5 September 2026).

pork-schnitzel.reason: Same dish: pork loin beaten thin, breaded loosely and fried at 170 C while swirling the pan. Both published 5 September 2026; schnitzel carries the dish's usual name.

pulled-pork-sandwich.reason: Same dish: rubbed pork shoulder slow-roasted for hours, pulled and dressed with a cider-vinegar sauce, served in buns with slaw. Both published 5 September 2026; pulled-pork carries the dish's usual name.

sfiha.reason: Same dish: small open yeasted rounds topped with minced lamb, tomato, tahini and pomegranate molasses, baked hot. sfiha-baalbakieh was published first (9 September 2026).

sloppy-joe-mix.reason: Same dish: beef mince browned undisturbed, simmered with onion, green pepper, tomato, sugar, Worcestershire and mustard, on soft buns. sloppy-joes was published first (5 September 2026).
